name: Input Buffer
description: Practice click patterns: buffer early presses, or snap clicks to a recorded reference run and die when they're outside the timing window.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description:
Buffer: hold early presses until the player can act.
Record reference: record your inputs; a completed run is saved as this level's reference.
Snap to reference: clicks within the snap window of a reference input fire on the reference step; anything else kills the player.

buffer-frames.name: Buffer Frames
buffer-frames.description: How many physics steps a press is held while the player cannot act yet. 0 disables buffering.

snap-window.name: Snap Window
snap-window.description: Snap mode: how many physics steps early or late an input may be and still count. 0 means it must be exact.
